note: The pre-Bash command-scanning guards match on the TEXT OF THE COMMAND, not on what it runs -- so writing a heredoc whose CONTENT mentions cargo test or --workspace is refused even though the only command is cat. Two of us hit it independently today writing ledger notes and plan documents that quote the gate ladder. Workarounds: prefix HV_TEST_OK=1 (the refusal message names it), or use the Edit/Write tool instead of a heredoc. Worth knowing before you conclude a doc write is failing for a real reason -- the message talks about test runs and reads like it is about to do something expensive, when you are only writing prose about them.
